01 — The Studio

An Arts-District
Institution

Tucked into the storefronts of Elmwood Avenue, Studios at 806 has been part of the neighborhood's creative fabric for over two decades.

806 Elmwood Ave

Since 2003, Studios at 806 has done hair the Elmwood Village way — personal, unhurried, and a little bit artful. Our chairs are home to both independent stylists and in-salon professionals, each bringing their own craft and clientele under one roof.

Regulars who've been with us for years, first-timers chasing a new look — the studio runs on the mix. Come as you are; leave as the version of yourself you've been picturing.

  • Two color houses — Davines & Redken professional color
  • Independent artists — stylists running their own chairs
  • In-salon professionals — the house team, Tue–Sat
  • Elmwood Village — Buffalo's arts & shopping district
02 — Studio Menu

Services

The essentials, done properly — cuts, color, styling, and a scalp massage to finish. Call the studio and we'll find the right chair and the right time.

Haircuts

/ 01

Precision cutting for all hair types and lengths — from sharp, structured shapes to soft, lived-in layers. Finished with a style so you leave knowing how it wears.

All lengthsCut & finish

Hair Color

/ 02

Full color, dimension, and lightening services using two professional color houses — the Davines color line and the classic versatility of Redken.

DavinesRedkenFull & dimensional color

Styling

/ 03

Blowouts, waves, and occasion styling for the days when your hair needs to show up — weddings, gallery nights, headshots, or just because.

BlowoutsOccasion styling

Scalp Massage

/ 04

The quiet luxury of the studio. A relaxing scalp massage to add to your service — unwind in the chair while we take care of the rest.
